name: Bambu Kahvaltısı
scene: A seated giant panda eats a leafy bamboo shoot in a lush bamboo grove.
notes: Redrawn from story_panda with fox and poppies design sheets as style references; target 91–131 panes. Panda uses indigo and honey; bamboo and surrounding grove use jade and turquoise. Visually reviewed both generation attempts. First retained because the retry introduced transparent exterior and a loose paw stroke. Remaining doubts: subtle shading rather than perfectly flat fills; adjacent same-colour panes in ears, face, limbs and bamboo may merge during tracing; crowded leaf contacts near muzzle and lower paws need junction review. Pane count and production geometry have not been validated. Design sheet only.
